async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Wait for the page to be fully loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure content is stable
    
    # Get the second article (index 1) under main
    second_article = page.get_by_role('article').nth(1)
    
    # Get the heading within the second article and then the link inside it
    heading_link = second_article.get_by_role('heading', level=2).get_by_role('link')
    
    # Click the link
    await heading_link.click()
